summary.text: Sarah Hewins is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Plymouth District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican John Gaskey.
She was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2018, losing to incumbent Susan Gifford.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Hewins advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary for the 2nd Plymouth District on September 4, 2018.
She lost the November 2018 general election to incumbent Republican Susan Gifford, 56.7% to 43.2%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
